content: Paired bootstrap for IR: compute per-query metric deltas (challenger - baseline) on the same query set; resample the delta array with replacement B=1000-10000 times; take the 2.5/97.5 percentiles of the resampled means as the 95% CI. If zero lies outside the CI the difference is significant at that level. Report mean delta + CI + N; Smucker et al. CIKM 2007 is the canonical IR citation; Efron & Tibshirani 1993 for the bootstrap itself. Pure-Python random.Random(seed) keeps the harness deterministic and dependency-free.
